name: Wheel Slipping Rule
recommendation: Inspect drive wheels for debris/oil; recalibrate traction controller.
explanation: High motor current with low odometry delta indicates drive wheels spinning without forward displacement.

name: Encoder Sensor Drift Rule
conclusion: Fault: Wheel Encoder Sensor Drift / Cable Disconnect
recommendation: Inspect encoder wiring harness and perform zero-point calibration.
explanation: IMU detected high rotational velocity while wheel encoders registered zero pulses, proving encoder signal loss.

name: Battery Cell Degradation Rule
conclusion: Fault: Battery Cell Degradation / High Internal Resistance
recommendation: Isolate battery pack and schedule cell balancing / replacement.
explanation: Voltage dropped rapidly under nominal (non-surge) current load, indicating elevated internal cell resistance.

name: Motor Overheating Rule
conclusion: Fault: Drive Motor Overheating / Stator Friction
recommendation: Halt vehicle, check cooling fans, and inspect gearbox for mechanical binding.
explanation: Drive motor core temperature exceeded 85C despite normal ambient conditions.

name: Gripper Mechanism Jam Rule
recommendation: Check gripper jaws for foreign object obstruction; lubricate linear guides.
explanation: Gripper motor drew stall current while optical limit switches indicated jaws never reached closed position.

name: LiDAR Window Occlusion Rule
conclusion: Fault: LiDAR Optical Window Dust Occlusion
recommendation: Wipe safety LiDAR lens with optical microfiber cloth.
explanation: LiDAR returned zero reflective points despite the robot being situated in a known open warehouse aisle.

name: Camera Vision Sensor Drift Rule
conclusion: Fault: Vision Camera Focus Drift / Smudged Lens
recommendation: Clean camera lens and run automated focal auto-calibration target.
explanation: Camera image Laplacian variance dropped below sharpness threshold under normal warehouse illumination.

name: Charging Dock Pin Corrosion Rule
conclusion: Fault: Charging Dock Contact Pin Oxidation / High Contact Resistance
recommendation: Clean copper charging pads on robot underside and dock station pins.
explanation: Mechanical limit switch confirmed dock engagement, but charge circuit drew 0.0A current.

name: Cargo Overload Rule
recommendation: Unload heaviest parcel immediately; verify cargo weight against 50kg limit.
explanation: Both load cell transducers and chassis suspension sensors reached maximum mechanical limits.

name: Emergency Stop Relay Trip Rule
conclusion: Fault: Safety Bumper Collision Trigger (E-Stop Active)
recommendation: Inspect physical bumper for structural damage; perform manual safety reset.
explanation: Safety bumper pressure strip opened the hardware emergency interlock loop.

name: IMU Gyro Drift Rule
recommendation: Perform 30-second stationary gyro bias recalibration on flat ground.
explanation: Heading state estimate accumulated angular rotation while vehicle was held in full mechanical brake.

name: Gearbox Backlash / Wear Rule
conclusion: Fault: Drive Gearbox Bearing Wear / Excessive Backlash
recommendation: Schedule gearbox maintenance; inspect planetary gear teeth for pitting.
explanation: High vibration spectrum coincided with acoustic peaks at gear mesh frequency.

name: Thermal Throttling Intermediate Rule
recommendation: Reduce maximum travel speed by 50% until system temperature normalizes.
explanation: Ambient warehouse temperature combined with controller heatsink temperature exceeded thermal operating envelope.

name: Wi-Fi Communication Dropout Rule
conclusion: Fault: Warehouse Fleet Network Dead Zone / RF Interference
recommendation: Switch to redundant sub-GHz channel; navigate to nearest Wi-Fi access point.
explanation: Consecutive packet loss exceeded 80% while RSSI dropped below -85 dBm.

name: Hydraulic / Pneumatic Pressure Loss Rule
conclusion: Fault: Lift System Pneumatic Pressure Leak
recommendation: Check high-pressure quick-connect lines and check valves for air leakage.
explanation: Lift manifold pressure failed to reach 6 bar despite auxiliary compressor operating at 100% duty cycle.

name: Watchdog Firmware Timeout Rule
conclusion: Fault: Subsystem Microcontroller Crash / CAN Bus Lockup
recommendation: Cycle 24V bus power; pull crash dump logs from secondary flash memory.
explanation: Node heartbeat frames stopped arriving on CAN bus; transceiver entered error-passive mode.

name: Compound Drivetrain Failure Rule
conclusion: CRITICAL FAULT: Severe Drivetrain Lockup & Thermal Hazard
recommendation: Immediately cut main power contactor; tow robot to maintenance shop.
explanation: Continuous wheel slipping sustained high motor current, causing secondary motor thermal runaway.

name: Compound Dock Contention Starvation Rule
conclusion: CRITICAL FAULT: Power Starvation (Autonomous Shutdown Imminent)
recommendation: Deploy manual technician with portable charger or dispatch reserve towing bot.
explanation: Battery voltage reached critical cut-off threshold while charging dock was contested/occupied.
